question: In ______, Gautam Buddhas delivered his first sermon at Sarnath.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhamma-chakra-pravartana Mudra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After enlightenment, **Lord Buddha** gave his **first sermon **to his** five disciples** in a deer park at **Sarnath** near** Varanasi.**
 
• This event of his life is known as **"Dharmachakrapravartana**".
 
• Thus **Dharmachakra Mudra** is the gesture of Buddha as depicted in his first sermon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gautam Buddha**

 
 
• He was a **Shakya prince** and was born in **Lumbini, present-day Nepal.**
 
• Buddha attained his enlightenment at **Bodh Gaya** after 49 days of deep meditation since then he was called the **Buddha **or the Enlightened one.
 
• He delivered his first sermon at **Sarnath, near Varanasi.**
 
• He attained Mahaparvanirvana at **Kushinagar.**
 
• **Buddha taught Four Noble Truths:**
 
 
• The world is full of suffering.
 
• The main cause of suffering is desire.
 
• To overcome the suffering one must give up desire.
 
• One will attain nirvana if desires are given up.
 
 
 
• Buddha suggested the** Eightfold Path **that would help people to attain Nirvana. It comprises of-right action, right determination, right exercise, right livelihood, right meditation, right memory, right observation, and right speech.
 
• The followers of Buddha formed Sangha and spread his teachings. Ashoka spread the teachings of Buddha to Sri Lanka and South-East Asia
 
• The Buddhist literature includes Jataka Tales and Tripitaka that were written in Pali.
